evidence.notes: Observed R, O, Y, A, L and 1 cross-checked in ROYAL 1 and ROYAL 18; 8 is observed only in ROYAL 18. types.label: Commercial truck
types.summary: Commercial truck plates: T in 1924, C from 1936, numeric and suffix series in the 1970s, then the ordinary flag plate with truck serial formats from 1985.

types.label: Farm tractor & farm truck
types.summary: F plates for farm tractors from 1948 and A (later G) plates for farm trucks from 1961; no FARM legend on any base.

types.label: Trailers
types.summary: Trailer, commercial trailer (COMM-TLR-), utility trailer and trailer floater plates, 1921 onward.

types.label: Motorcycle
types.summary: Small-format motorcycle plates and motorcycle dealer plates, 1949 onward.

types.label: Dealer & trade
types.summary: Dealer (Demonstration), Manufacturer, Repairer and Transporter plates, 1913 onward.

types.label: Industrial & logging
types.summary: Industrial Vehicle (X), Logging Truck, Special Agreement, Restricted and Off-Road plates.

types.label: Carrier & prorate
types.summary: Motor Carrier, Passenger Carrier, Motive Fuel, Prorate/Apportioned and Reciprocity plates, plus a possible temporary X plate.

types.label: Specialty & optional
types.summary: Optional and specialty bases: BC Parks, 2010 Olympics, Veteran, Memorial Cross, Collector, Antique and Personalized.

types.label: Consular
types.summary: Plates for consular officers and foreign representatives, from the 1967 CONSUL plates to the 2007 red base.

types.label: Amateur radio
types.summary: Call-sign plates for licensed operators from 1963: VE7 (and VA7 from 1999) plus two or three letters, on the passenger base of the day.

types.label: Government & official
types.summary: Class prefixes on passenger bases (PW, doctors, government E, National Defence N), the red-bordered National Parks plates, federal CANADA plates, early Victoria and foreign-touring issues, and the Lieutenant Governor’s plates.

types.label: Events & ceremonial
types.summary: Royal tours and visits, Expo 86 and the 1997 APEC summit.

types.label: Municipal & exempt
types.summary: Commercial-vehicle licence plates: issued by individual municipalities (often by half-year) until 1962, by the City of Vancouver into the 2000s, and by the province as a single MUNICIPAL plate (with EXEMPT) from 1963 to 1986.

types.label: Bicycle
types.summary: Bicycle licence plates issued by municipalities, from Vancouver’s 1901 brass tags to the 1970s tin and plastic plates.

types.label: Samples, prototypes & props
types.summary: Official samples, unissued designs, film props and reproductions — none are issued registrations.
